transcript.content: Hello, welcome in — I'm Dr. Smith. What brings you in to see me today?

I came in because things have really gone downhill since they changed my hours at the warehouse and brought in that new inventory system. I feel like I’m falling apart. I’ve been missing shifts, missing church commitments, snapping at my family. Some mornings I’m sitting there in my work boots, just wondering if I can even make myself go in.
When exactly did you start noticing these feelings and behaviors — was it right around when your hours and the new inventory system changed, or did it start earlier?
It started within the first few weeks after they changed the hours and put in that new system. Before that, I was managing my routine and my responsibilities all right.
Since this all started, have you noticed a loss of interest or pleasure in things you used to enjoy, or a persistent low mood most of the day, nearly every day?
I’m not sure I’d say it’s like that all day, every day. It’s more that I get overwhelmed thinking about work and everything I’m supposed to keep up with.
Have you been feeling unusually nervous, on edge, or worried much of the time since this started, perhaps with physical symptoms like a racing heart or muscle tension?
I’m not really sure. I know I get overwhelmed when I think about work, but I haven’t noticed those kinds of physical symptoms.
Besides feeling overwhelmed, have you noticed yourself acting out in ways that are out of character for you—like being more irritable, getting into conflicts, or breaking rules you'd normally follow?

Yeah. I’ve been snapping at my family, which isn’t like me. And I’ve missed some shifts, even church commitments. Some mornings I just sit there in my work boots, wondering if I can even make myself go back to that warehouse.
Aside from feeling overwhelmed and irritable, have you also been feeling notably sad, anxious, or worried since this all began?
Yes, I have. Since they changed my hours and brought in that new inventory system, I’ve been worried all the time about going in. It just feels like I’m falling apart over it.
When you find yourself sitting there wondering if you can make yourself go in, have you had any thoughts of hurting yourself or not wanting to be alive?
I’m not sure what you mean by that. I just know I sit there feeling like I can’t face going in.
